source_message.text:
Hello Nadia. I have now edited the manuscript, but I still need your help with these points:
1\. My name appears at the top of the first page. Should it remain there?
2\. Please add page numbers to the manuscript.
3\. I cannot format the title of the 14th chapter; please look into it.
4\. The other chapter titles, subtitles, and Table of Content also need your review.
